# Skills, not syllabi

> Operational agent skills. How to do the job, not how to teach it.

Library of SKILL.md playbooks for coding agents. Paste the repo. Read AGENTS.md. Load one skill.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): runbook if you were handed this URL
- [README.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/README.md): install + library table
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): pointer at AGENTS.md

## Skills

- [learn-codebase](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/learn-codebase/SKILL.md): unfamiliar repo, leveled passes, prove-it
- [grill-execute-clear](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/grill-execute-clear/SKILL.md): grill design, same-session execute, clear
- [to-spec](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/to-spec/SKILL.md): destination spec + vertical tickets in the tracker
- [ralph-loop](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/ralph-loop/SKILL.md): cross-session ticket queue, gate outside the worker
- [handoff](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/handoff/SKILL.md): phase-boundary tree
- [compact](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/compact/SKILL.md): one-line-focus compact, implement→QA
- [kill-context-bloat](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/kill-context-bloat/SKILL.md): measure, cut, quit, relaunch, remeasure
- [session-hygiene](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/session-hygiene/SKILL.md): portable session habits
- [claude-code-habits](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/claude-code-habits/SKILL.md): Claude Code commands
- [steering-push-vs-point](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/skills/steering-push-vs-point/SKILL.md): AGENTS.md vs on-demand skills

## Docs

- [glossary](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/docs/glossary.md): smart zone, dumb zone, phase tree
- [LANDMINES](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/docs/LANDMINES.md): claims that must not regress
- [AUTHORING](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/docs/AUTHORING.md): add a skill
- [CONFIG-SCHEMA](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/docs/CONFIG-SCHEMA.md): per-repo config
- [HARNESS-MATRIX](https://github.com/Thingscorp/skills/blob/main/docs/HARNESS-MATRIX.md): action → harness command
